title: Ecclesiastes Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Ecclesiastes 6: the man who cannot enjoy his riches, the stillborn child, the unfilled appetite, and life spent like a shadow.

questions.text: In the evil described in this chapter, who eats the riches that God gives a man no power to eat of?
questions.explanation: The verse describes a man to whom God gives riches, wealth and honor, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it.

questions.text: According to this chapter, who is better than a man who fathers a hundred children but whose soul is not filled with good?
questions.explanation: He says that if a man fathers a hundred children and lives many years but his soul is not filled with good and he has no burial, a stillborn child is better than he.

questions.text: What does this chapter say the stillborn child has, rather than the other?
questions.explanation: The verse says the stillborn has not seen the sun nor known it, yet this has rest rather than the other.

questions.text: What question does the speaker ask about the man who lives a thousand years twice told yet fails to enjoy good?
questions.explanation: The verse says that though he live a thousand years twice told and yet fails to enjoy good, don't all go to one place?

questions.text: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet what is not filled?
questions.explanation: The verse says all the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

questions.text: What does this chapter say is better than the wandering of the desire?
questions.explanation: The verse says better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire; this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

questions.text: With whom can man not contend, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says that whatever has been, its name was given long ago, and man cannot contend with him who is mightier than he.

answers.text: Him who is mightier than he

questions.text: What does this chapter say many words create?
questions.explanation: The verse says there are many words that create vanity, and asks what that profits man.

questions.text: How does the last verse say a man spends the days of his vain life?
questions.explanation: The verse speaks of all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow.

questions.text: What question about the future closes this chapter?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends by asking who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun.

answers.text: "When will the end of all things come?"
"Who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?"
"Will the wise man be remembered forever?"
"Who will sit on the king's throne?"
